source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the uncertainty principle (PDF 131-133).

blocks.text: Zarre ki jagah aur momentum dono aik saath mukammal durusti se nahi nape ja sakte. Aisi har paimaish mein hamesha aik bunyadi ghair-yaqeeniyat (uncertainty) hoti hai. Yeh napne ke aale ki wajah se nahi balke maddah aur shuaon ki lehar-zarra dohri fitrat ka nateeja hai. Ise pehli dafa Werner Heisenberg ne 1927 mein pesh kiya aur yeh Heisenberg ka uncertainty principle kehlata hai. Rozmarra cheezon ki jagah aur momentum ke liye yeh ghair-yaqeeniyat na-qabil-e-zikr hai lekin atomic duniya mein ghalib hai: urti tennis gend se takrane wale photons ki dhaar us ka rasta mushkil se badalti hai, lekin electron se takrane wala aik photon us ki harkat bilkul badal deta hai.

Kyunke roshni lehar ki khasiyatein rakhti hai, hum electron ki jagah istemal hone wali roshni ki taqreeban aik wavelength tak hi maloom kar sakte hain. Kam ghair-yaqeeniyat se jagah maloom karne ke liye chhoti wavelength ki roshni chahiye, lekin woh us ki harkat zyada badalti aur momentum ki paimaish kam durust banati hai. Agar x-mehwar par chalte zarre ki jagah maloom karne ke liye lambda wavelength ki roshni use ho to jagah ki ghair-yaqeeniyat dx taqreeban lambda hai. Zyada se zyada photon apna poora momentum h/lambda zarre ko de sakta hai, jis ka momentum phir dp taqreeban h/lambda ghair-yaqeeni hai. Zarb dene se dx dp taqreeban lambda (h/lambda) = h (18.14).

blocks.title: Jagah-momentum uncertainty principle
blocks.text: Kisi lamhe zarre ki jagah ki ghair-yaqeeniyat dx aur usi lamhe us ke momentum ke x-hisse ki ghair-yaqeeniyat dp ka hasil-e-zarb taqreeban Planck constant h ke barabar hai. Heisenberg ka zyada mohtaat hisaab behtareen surat mein dx dp >= h-bar deta hai, jahan h-bar = h/(2 pi) = 1.05 x 10^-34 J s.

Uncertainty principle dikhata hai ke electrons nucleus ke andar nahi reh sakte. Nucleus ka qutr 10^-15 m ke darje ka hai, is liye andar electron ki jagah ki ghair-yaqeeniyat taqreeban 10^-15 m aur momentum ki ghair-yaqeeniyat dp taqreeban h/dx = 6.63 x 10^-34 / 10^-15 = 6.63 x 10^-19 kg m s^-1 hogi. Mutalliqa tawanai GeV ke darje ki hogi (pc taqreeban 1.2 GeV), jo atom mein kisi electron ki tawanai se kaheen zyada hai. Is liye electrons nucleus ke andar nahi hote.

blocks.title: Kitab mein ikaiyan
blocks.text: Kitab is momentum ki ghair-yaqeeniyat ko 6.63 x 10^-19 'J s' deti hai; momentum kg m s^-1 (ya N s) mein napa jata hai.

Uncertainty principle ki aik aur shakal zarre ki tawanai ko us waqt se jorti hai jitni der woh tawanai rakhta hai: dE dt taqreeban h (18.15, 18.16), ya behtareen surat mein dE dt >= h-bar. Hum zarre ki tawanai jitni durusti se maloom karein, utne hi ghair-yaqeeni hote hain ke woh tawanai kitni der rehti hai. Heisenberg ko quantum physics mein hissa dalne par 1932 ka Physics Nobel Prize mila. Is usool ki wajah se atomic duniya mein har tajurbati paimaish mein kuch ghair-yaqeeniyat lazmi hai; zer-e-atomic duniya mein bohat kam cheezein 100 feesad durusti se predict ho sakti hain.

Atom ke size, 1.0 x 10^-10 m, ke dabbe mein band electron ki velocity kya ho sakti hai? Hal: dp dx taqreeban h, dp taqreeban m dv ke saath, is liye dv = h/(m dx) = 6.63 x 10^-34 / (9.1 x 10^-31 x 1.0 x 10^-10) = 7.3 x 10^6 m s^-1.

Taqreeban 10^-8 s tak shua kharij karne wale atom ke photon ki tawanai ki ghair-yaqeeniyat maloom karein. Hal: dE dt taqreeban h, is liye dE = h/dt = 6.63 x 10^-34 / 10^-8 = 6.63 x 10^-26 J. Electron volts mein dE = 6.63 x 10^-26 / 1.6 x 10^-19 = 4 x 10^-7 eV.

blocks.prompt: Uncertainty principle cricket ki gend ke liye ghair-ahem lekin electron ke liye ahem kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Kyunke h bohat chhota hai: bhari gend ke liye velocity ki ghair-yaqeeniyat (h/(m dx)) mehsoos karne ke liye bohat chhoti, lekin atomic faaslon mein qaid nanhi kamiyat wale electron ke liye velocity ki ghair-yaqeeniyat lakhon metre fi second hai.

items: Uncertainty principle (Heisenberg, 1927): dx dp taqreeban h (behtareen >= h/2 pi).
Tawanai-waqt shakal: dE dt taqreeban h.
Electrons nucleus mein nahi ho sakte; atomic paimane par paimaish mein hamesha ghair-yaqeeniyat.
